name: Vertical Nav
description: A compound vertical navigation with icon-rail and full-text modes.

anatomy.description: The labeled nav container; rail mode collapses it to an icon strip that expands on hover or focus.
VerticalNavBrand holds the product mark; in full mode it can pair an icon with a wordmark.
VerticalNavSection groups items under a label that fades in when the rail expands.
VerticalNavItem pairs an always-visible icon with a label; active sets aria-current and a circular icon background in rail mode.
VerticalNavFooter pins secondary destinations like settings to the bottom.

dos: Give every item an icon so rail mode stays usable while labels are collapsed.
Drive active from the router so the current page sets aria-current.
Use mode="full" inside a mobile drawer where labels should always show.
donts: Don't nest sections more than one level deep; use Tree View for deeper hierarchies.
Don't mix icons on only some items in a section; rail mode depends on consistent icons.
Don't keep the rail attached on narrow screens; move it into a dismissible drawer instead.

examples.title: Rail and full modes
examples.description: Rail mode collapses to an icon strip and expands on hover or keyboard focus; the active item shows a circular background around its icon. Full mode shows labels always with a rounded row highlight.

examples.title: Application shell
examples.description: Compose a persistent rail with a full navigation drawer for responsive products.

examples.title: Router integration
examples.description: Use VerticalNavItem with a router link and pass active state from the route.

guidance.useWhen: An application needs persistent section navigation.
guidance.avoidWhen: There are only a few inline links or a short wizard.
guidance.behavior: Rail mode expands on hover or focus, the active item shows a circular background around its icon, and item active state sets aria-current.
guidance.responsive: Use full navigation in a drawer on mobile and close it after route changes.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between nav items. In rail mode, focusing an item expands the nav.

notes: Rail mode expands on hover and on focus-within, so keyboard users can read labels that are hidden from mouse users until hover.
The active item sets aria-current="page" to mark the current location for screen readers.
Use the icon prop for the leading icon so it stays visible in rail mode; only the label fades.

props.description: Rail collapses labels until hover or focus; full keeps labels visible.
props.name: mode

props.description: Edge where the navigation is attached.
props.name: side

props.description: Uppercase heading shown above the items. Hidden in rail mode until the nav expands.
props.name: label

props.description: Marks the item as the current page; sets `aria-current="page"`. In rail mode the active background is a circle around the icon; in full mode it is a rounded row.
props.name: active

props.description: Icon element shown before the label. Always visible, even in rail mode.
props.name: icon
